grading: Correct only if every requested material fact resolved, no contradiction or unsupported guess. Partial for missing/unresolved parts, incorrect for any material contradiction. Judge content rather than support label.

answers.answer: Move the eighth marker to earn the top Fear card face-down, reset all 8 to the pool and put the remaining 2 generated Fear toward the next card. Terror II applies as soon as exposed (subject to outcome check at action-tree end). Keep card hidden until Fear step, resolving in earned order at the then-current Terror level only.

Damage normally means to Invaders only, distributed as chosen in target land; can combine within turn, immediately destroying pieces at Damage >= Health. Destroying Town/City produces 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear. Remove/Replace generate none automatically; Replace retains prior Damage and may cause destruction if Damage meets new Health (then destruction Fear applies). Surviving Damage clears at Time Passes. Dahan are harmed by Powers only if explicitly stated. An outright Destroy instruction eliminates its specified piece regardless of its Damage or Health. Remove likewise takes the specified piece off the board without requiring Damage to reach Health. Replace removes the original and puts the specified replacement in its place.

answers.answer: Yes; for each Dahan destroyed by that Ravage, destroy one of Thunderspeaker’s Presence within Range 1 after the entire single-land Ravage, including any Blight/cascades/Presence loss and counterattack. Blight is not a prerequisite.

Separate Powers do not combine hypothetical Damage and each does nothing to undamaged City. Single Power’s instructions combine to would-destroy City and earn 5 Fear, leaving City actually unchanged. Repeat is separate action and can pretend-destroy same piece again if its own Damage suffices; cannot combine its hypothetical Damage with original.
